note: Gate names are GitHub check-run names. A gate that did not execute on the exact commit is NOT passed. See docs/TEST-ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/CI-POLICY.md.

foundation.description: Cheap offline/JVM evidence. Enough for iteration, never for integration of UI, Add, navigation or remote behavior.

integration.description: Required before merging a change to shared Add, navigation, persistence, remote RPC or operation gating (docs/CI-POLICY.md).

integration-real-peer.description: integration plus the installed real-peer Add journey. Required when Add, source intake or remote Add behavior changed.
